summary: The candidate adds a useful but bypassable startup rejection for one spelling of bundled GLM5 NextN plus EAGLE3. It does not repair or validate the original EAGLE3/MTP path, acceptance quality, or the bundled head representation contract. Equivalent names for the same checkpoint bypass the guard and leave the original width mismatch reachable.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before test availability: the candidate regression did not exist on the recorded base.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-91edb81cb85f/venv/bin/python implementation-level GLM5 EAGLE3 capture reproduction (on base)
tests.what_was_measured: Actual GLM5 methods selected layers [2, 22, 42]; with H=4096 and hc_mult=4, one non-DFLASH capture was [2,16384] and three packed captures were [2,49152], not the H-wide previous hidden expected by the bundled NextN head.
Candidate-focused tests passed: 6 passed. These prove helper behavior and the pre-existing DFLASH contraction, not a working GLM5 EAGLE3/MTP model path.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-91edb81cb85f/venv/bin/python independent _validate_native_mtp_algorithm path-alias matrix (at exact candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: Exact equal paths were rejected, while trailing-slash, dot-component, alternate mount/symlink, and hub-revision spellings were allowed.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-91edb81cb85f/venv/bin/python independent gfx950 _prepare_aux_hidden_state comparison (at exact candidate)
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950, pre-existing DFLASH contraction produced [3,4096] with max_abs_diff 0.0 versus reshape-and-mean; EAGLE3/non-DFLASH retained [3,16384].

gpu_evidence: One assigned AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 executed an independent numerical check of the existing mHC contraction. This does not reproduce the reported NVIDIA H20 fused kernel or validate a full model.
native_rebuild_evidence: The candidate changes only Python and test/report files; no native source changed, so no native rebuild was applicable.
remaining_counterexamples: The same local checkpoint expressed as target '/models/glm5' and draft '/models/glm5/' bypasses the rejection.
The same local checkpoint expressed through dot components, a symlink, or a bind-mount alias bypasses the rejection.
A hub checkpoint expressed with an equivalent revision-qualified spelling can bypass raw string equality.
After any bypass, the unchanged GLM5 EAGLE3 path still captures three 4H mHC states and can supply a width incompatible with the H-wide bundled NextN input.
No evidence shows that NEXTN/EAGLE on the bundled head achieves correct acceptance or throughput, so the original acceptance approximately 1.0 report remains unresolved.
A distinct EAGLE3 draft is allowed by the candidate but was not validated for architecture compatibility or execution.
remaining_limitations: GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable; no full server, logits, acceptance length, or throughput test was run.
The reported 4x H20 TP=4 environment was unavailable; testing used one AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950.
The CUDA fused_eh_norm path could not be executed on this ROCm host.
The candidate's claim about what representation the bundled head was trained to consume could not be independently verified.
